meta_title: Reading Habit Tracker with Streaks | BookWorm
meta_desc: Build a reading habit with a daily page or minute goal, a streak that grows each day you reach it, a reading calendar and one calm reminder a day.
og_title: A reading habit tracker that's kind to you
og_desc: A daily goal, a streak that grows, a calendar of reading days and one calm reminder a day.
h1: A little every day adds up to a lot.
lede: Pick a daily goal you can keep. BookWorm counts the days you reach it, lights up your calendar, and nudges you once a day, gently.
shot_alt: Reading Quests in BookWorm: 36 of 30 pages today, goal reached, and a 16-day streak.
shot2_alt: The BookWorm reading calendar with 18 reading days and a 16-day streak.
points_lede: Every piece is there to make tomorrow's reading a little more likely than today's.
p1_t: A goal sized for real life
p1_d: Choose pages or minutes a day, from 5 upwards. BookWorm also turns it into the number of books it adds up to this year.
p2_d: Each day you reach your goal, the worm grows a segment. Its head lights up the moment today counts.
p3_d: Every day you read gets a mark, and every book you finish gets a gold ring. A month at a glance shows the rhythm you've built.
p4_d: One reminder at lunchtime, written for where you are, and a last call in the evening only when a streak is on the line. Nothing at all once today's goal is met.
deep_title: Miss a day? Start again tomorrow.
deep_p1: Streaks are a nudge, not a judge. If a day slips, the streak starts again and the next day is a fresh start, with a reminder that says exactly that.
deep_p2: Your best streak stays on your profile, and on the first of each month BookWorm shows a recap of the month you just read.
deep_link: Read the guide to building a reading habit
q1: What counts as a day in my streak?
a1: Any day you reach your daily goal, in pages or minutes. Reading and listening both count.
q2: What daily reading goal should I choose?
a2: One you could meet on a busy day. Ten to twenty pages, or fifteen minutes, is a good start, and you can raise it any time.
q3: How many reminders will I get?
a3: At most one at lunchtime and, only when your streak is at risk, one in the evening. None on a day you've already reached your goal.
q4: Can I see my streak without opening the app?
a4: Yes. The Home Screen widgets show today's goal as a ring and your current streak.
